value.name: Daniel notices Lucia and the folder
value.description: Daniel steps back from the threshold and his expression changes when he sees Lucia beside Asha and the folder under her arm.
evidence: ee steps back from the threshold with both hands half-raised in the reasonable posture he had been practicing through the wood, and his face changed when he saw Lucia beside her and the folder under her arm.

value.name: Asha positions herself protectively
value.description: Asha moves slightly ahead of Lucia in the narrow hallway, holding the folder tightly and masking her expression.
evidence: Asha shifted half a step ahead of Lucia in the narrow hallway, the folder pressed flat under her arm and her fingers curled white around its handle, and she let her face go quiet in the way she used in hearings when she did not want a man to read her.

value.name: Lucia trembles beside Asha
value.description: Lucia keeps her eyes down and trembles close enough for Asha to feel it through her jacket.
evidence: Behind her shoulder, Lucia kept her eyes on the runner carpet and gathered the cuff of her sleeve in a tight, trembling pinch, close enough that Asha could feel the small tremor through the fabric of her own jacket.

value.name: Daniel asks to discuss the papers
value.description: Daniel lowers his hands and speaks softly, asking whether Asha has finished reviewing everything and suggesting they sit down like family to sort out the papers.
evidence: Daniel lowered his hands by a few inches and his gaze with them, and when he spoke his voice came out softer than before, almost solicitous, asking whether she had finally finished going through everything and whether they could sit down like family and sort out what the papers really meant.

value.name: Asha withholds a response
value.description: Asha refuses to answer Daniel and holds his gaze in silence.
evidence: Asha did not answer; she only held the look

value.name: Asha infers Lucia's history with Daniel
value.description: Hearing Lucia react to the word family, Asha realizes Daniel has been significant in Lucia's life for years.
evidence: in the silence she heard Lucia's breath catch once at the word family, which told her more clearly than the signature upstairs what this man had been to this woman for years.

value.name: Asha reveals she has seen through Daniel
value.description: Asha lets Daniel see that she understands him and waits without yielding.
evidence: she let him see that she had seen him, and waited.

value.name: Asha breaks the silence and reaches for the folder
value.description: After holding the silence, Asha begins to slide the blue folder out from under her arm.
